Department of Endocrinology, General Hospital of Chinese PLA, Beijing 100853, China[Abstract] Inhaled glucocorticoids or intranasal glucocorticoids were previously considered safe, but in recent years, more and more reports show that inhaled glucocorticoids or intranasal glucocorticoids caused iatrogenic Cushing's syndrome, especially in patients taking CYP3A4 inhibitors at the same time. Therefore, this article reviews the iatrogenic Cushing's syndrome caused by drug interactions.吸入性糖皮质激素(inhaled corticosteroid， I C S)或鼻内用糖皮质激素 (i n t r a n a s a lcorticosteroids，INCS)被广泛用于治疗哮喘和慢性阻塞性肺疾病(chronic obstructive pulmonary disease，COPD)、过敏性鼻炎(allergic rhinitis，AR)、支气管哮喘(bronchial asthma，BA)等呼吸系统疾病，其主要的不良反应(adverse drug reaction，ADR)分为局部和全身，局部ADR包括发音障碍、口咽部假丝酵母菌病(鹅口疮)、接触性的超敏反应等；
